methodology: Closed loop, no think time, one worker per concurrent request. Latency begins at dispatch (no artificial client queue). TTFT is first nonempty streamed text chunk. Warmup excluded. Throughput counts successful completion tokens / full run wall time, including failed requests. A failed request invalidates the experiment; there are no retries.
